title: Can’t believe I got see Jenn Colella sing “Me and the Sky” in the yea...
transcript: I got to attend a very special concert presentation of Come From Away in remembrance of the 25th anniversary of 9/11. This concert brought together past cast members from Come From Away, including several members of the original Broadway cast, and was being performed at the Perelman Performing Arts Center, which is literally right across the street from the 9/11 Memorial. So, as you might imagine, it was a pretty emotional evening. Like, I sobbed throughout most of the show. Not only is it, in my opinion, one of the greatest musicals ever written, but seeing it in the location where the attacks took place, it just was so special in a way that is hard to put into words. Switching gears to the actual production itself, I thought it was surprisingly well rehearsed. I don't know how much time they had to prepare. And obviously these are roles that they've all done before, but for many of them, it's been a while. And yet they did the entire show completely off book, used all of the costumes from the Broadway production, and even had a fair bit of staging, or at least as much staging as they could do standing in front of microphones. It wasn't a full production by any means, but it was basically the next best thing, and everyone was on the top of their game, from the performers themselves, the band, the sign language interpreters. You could tell it meant just as much To them, to be able to present this story as it did to us, to be able to receive it. 9/11 is obviously one of the worst things to ever happen in this country, and it is incredibly important every year to remember those that we lost. But I love that this show also shines a spotlight on the fact that even in the darkest of times, there is still goodness in humanity. And chooses to remember the kindness and community that came in the days following the attacks. Tickets were completely free, but they went very quickly, and so I felt very lucky to be one of the few that actually got a ticket and got to experience this in person, because it really is an evening that I don't think I'll ever forget.
classificationReason: Creator attended and reviewed a concert presentation of Come From Away (25th anniversary of 9/11 at Perelman Performing Arts Center). While a genuine first-hand opinion is shared, Come From Away does not appear on the provided list of productions.
